page.overview:
Who is Conney?

Conney is the queen dowager of the Sorbet Kingdom as the mother of King Bulldog.

Conney is a short, wrinkled elderly woman with light hair. She wears an ornate dress, a fur coat and a side cap. Six years ago, her side cap was dark with a light brim, but around three and a half years ago, it is light overall.

Conney is a calm, motherly individual who once took Bonney under her wing. Despite her old age, Conney is actually wise and cunning, being able to deduce that the World Government had ill intentions towards Bonney when they were posing as her caretakers.

As queen dowager of Sorbet, Conney has some degree of political authority. None of Mary Geoise's Royal Guards questioned her presence around the time of the Levely, implying that she could have been important enough to have been invited for the event.
